messages:
marta: Heads-up — lightning just hit something by Ashby station and the signal lights went dark. BART between MacArthur and Richmond is crawling. Anyone near Rockridge need a lift to the downtown office?
ryan: I saw a puff of smoke over the tracks, train slowed to a crawl. Switched to 880 express but buses are packed.
jaya: Gonna WFH — no way I'm juggling preschool + an unpredictable commute today :sweat_smile:
alex: I have 2 seats in a Prius leaving North Oakland (Temescal) at 8:10. PM me if you want in. Can drop at 3rd/Market. :car:
ops-bot: AC Transit alert: Route 51 detour on Telegraph Ave due to police activity. Expect 15-25 min delays. https://status.actransit.org/incident/12345
brett: There's an umbrella stash by the 3rd-floor kitchen — label what you take so it can come back later :umbrella:
marco: Ugh my bike rack basement area got a puddle under it, wiped down my saddle. If anyone needs a quick pump+patch I have a kit in my locker.
marta: Also — quick ask: if you grabbed an umbrella from the stash, hop in #random and drop where you left it so others know.
ryan: For folks still deciding: BART says 'resuming with residual delays', but no ETA. If you need a ride DM me, I might detour.
jaya: Poll by emoji: :house: = WFH, :office: = coming in. React and we'll tally in 15.
alex: Also posted a photo of the signal (no gore, just sparks) in the thread. If you're commuting, stay back from the platforms until ops clears it.
marco: Thanks for the PSA alex. If anyone's stranded near Telegraph + 40th, I'm passing through in 20 min and can swing by.
ops-bot: Incident log: 1795500000 - Lightning strike reported; infrastructure team dispatched. Updates to follow.
brett: tiny comms note — office temp is cranked up because heat fused a fan; bring a layer if you come in later.
marta: Last call for carpool seats — I'll leave in 6. Stay safe everyone! :raising_hand:
